Synthetic cohort matched to the 107 PSST participants' AQ and item counts; 5 replicates. Items are IPNP objects (the PSST items are BNT/VNT short forms, which are harder; see data/README.md).

Correlation of synthetic accuracy with AQ: 0.91 (real: 0.81). Overall: real 0.47, synthetic 0.49.

PSST incorrect responses: 1667, of which 21% transcribe to a single English word and 79% do not. The latter mix phonological paraphasias with circumlocutions, fragments and multi-word attempts, because PSST codes correctness only. A response-type comparison needs the PSST transcripts coded into the six PNT categories (planned).

**3. Nonword distance from target (phoneme edits), by target length**

Synthetic nonwords are phonological paraphasias (edits of the target). The PSST column is every incorrect non-word transcript within two phonemes of the target's length, which includes unrelated speech, so it is an upper bound on how far real phonological errors sit from their targets.
